main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "For each test case, reads an integer sequence, separates the values by 0-based index parity into two arrays, sorts the parity arrays independently after forcing Integer.MAX_VALUE into the last even-array slot, and prints the first position where the interleaved sorted result violates nondecreasing order, or OK if no violation is found." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments passed to main; not used by the method body."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Scanner to read from standard input and store it as reader. RESULT reader]
            [COMMAND Read the first integer from standard input as numberOfTests, the number of test cases. RESULT numberOfTests]
            [COMMAND Initialize a to 0 and b to 0. RESULT a_b]
            [COMMAND For each test case with zero-based index m from 0 to numberOfTests - 1, use m + 1 when printing case numbers, and execute the following steps for that case. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, read the integer n for this test case from standard input. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, if n is odd set a = n / 2 + 1 and b = n / 2; otherwise set a = n / 2 and b = n / 2. Note that b is assigned but never used afterward. RESULT a_b]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, allocate int arrays oddArray and evenArray, each of length a. RESULT oddArray_evenArray]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, initialize indices c = 0 and d = 0. RESULT c_d]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, for each original index i from 0 to n - 1, read one integer from standard input: if i is even, store that integer in oddArray[c] and increment c; if i is odd, store that integer in evenArray[d] and increment d. RESULT oddArray_evenArray]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, after filling the arrays, set evenArray[evenArray.length - 1] to Integer.MAX_VALUE unconditionally, even if that slot already contains a real input value. RESULT evenArray]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, create a new Solution object named mms. RESULT mms]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, sort oddArray in place by calling mms.sort(oddArray). RESULT oddArray]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, sort evenArray in place by calling mms.sort(evenArray). RESULT evenArray]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, initialize failure marker x = 0. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer test-case loop, execute the validation loop for each h from 0 to oddArray.length - 1, wrapping the comparisons in a try block with an empty finally block that has no effect. RESULT validation_loop]
            [COMMAND Inside the validation loop for h, if oddArray[h] is greater than evenArray[h], print the case number and the even violation position 2*h (formatted as "Case #" + (m + 1) + ": " + (2 * h)), set x = 1, and break the validation loop. RESULT printed_violation]
            [COMMAND Inside the validation loop for h, if oddArray[h] is less than or equal to evenArray[h]: if h is the last index (h == oddArray.length - 1), break the validation loop as successful; otherwise, if evenArray[h] is greater than oddArray[h + 1], print the case number and the odd violation position 2*h + 1 (formatted as "Case #" + (m + 1) + ": " + (2 * h + 1)), set x = 1, and break the validation loop; if evenArray[h] is less than or equal to oddArray[h + 1], continue to the next value of h. RESULT printed_violation_or_continue]
            [COMMAND After the validation loop finishes for the current test case, if x == 0, print "Case #" + (m + 1) + ": OK". RESULT printed_ok]
            [COMMAND After all test cases have been processed by the outer loop, close the reader. RESULT reader_closed]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
